contracts.caveat: contracts.csv holds published notices, not a contract register. It holds awards published on Contracts Finder in roughly the last five years. A contract awarded earlier, one advertised only on Find a Tender, a framework call-off recorded under another buyer, or an exempt placement will have no notice here. 'No notice found' is therefore an indicator to check against the council's contract register, never evidence of off-contract spend. Contracts Finder does not carry awards below the publication threshold, so results must never be used to question smaller suppliers.

expired_notice_spend.description: suppliers paid in the spend window whose every exactly matched notice ended before the window started
expired_notice_spend.caveat: a newer contract may exist with no Contracts Finder notice; an indicator to check against the contract register, not evidence of spend without an extension

spend_vs_award.description: suppliers matched to one live single-supplier notice with an award value: annualised estimate divided by the award's annual rate, flagged at 1.25 or more

parameters.award_annual_rate: Awarded Value / contract years (start to end)

spend_vs_award.caveat: award values may be estimates or maxima, and the spend window is short; a high ratio is a question for the contract manager, not evidence of a variation
